items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Max took that from him. M’Boom, that was Roy!

ctx.x: I used to work Montreux Detroit, And one year he did this thing called “Giant Steps” and he incorporated a guy dribbling a basketball, he incorporated a martial arts, he had cats playing Afro Brazilian, he had every… It was almost like M’Boom.
M’Boom, he started that. Max took that from him. M’Boom, that was Roy!
It was crazy what he did. It was almost like-­
